# DrawImageRect <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DrawImageRect:Void image:Int32, x:Int32, y:Int32, rect_x:Int32, rect_y:Int32, rect_width:Int32, rect_height:Int32, frame:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | In | Int32 | required | The image to draw. |
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position on the screen of the top left corner of the part. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position on the screen of the top left corner of the part. |
| `rect_x` | In | Int32 | required | Left edge of the part inside the frame. |
| `rect_y` | In | Int32 | required | Top edge of the part inside the frame. |
| `rect_width` | In | Int32 | required | Width of the part. |
| `rect_height` | In | Int32 | required | Height of the part. |
| `frame` | In | Int32 | `0` | Which frame to draw. Defaults to 0. |

## Description

Draws only a rectangle of a frame, with the mask color left out. It can show a part of a big picture or cut a sheet into tiles. The handle of the image is not used: the top left corner of the rectangle goes to the given position.

## Differences

* Only the part that lies inside the frame is drawn. A rectangle that reaches over the edge is cut off.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(120, 120)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img)
For i = 0 To 5
	Color 255 - i * 40, 100 + i * 25, 60 + i * 30
	Rect i * 10, i * 10, 120 - i * 20, 120 - i * 20, 1
Next
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
DrawImage img, 20, 60
DrawImageRect img, 180, 80, 40, 40, 80, 80
Color 255, 255, 255
Rect 180 - 1, 80 - 1, 82, 82, 0
Flip
WaitKey
```
